videos.title: Final Destination 2
videos.description: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway.

videos.title: Final Destination 3
videos.description: Six years after a group of high-school students first cheated death, another teen (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) has a premonition that she and her friends will be involved in a horrifying roller-coaster accident. When the vision proves true, the student and her fellow survivors must deal with the repercussions of cheating the Grim Reaper.

videos.title: Final Destination 5
videos.description: During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied.

videos.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
videos.description: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

videos.title: Pitch Perfect 3
videos.description: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time.

videos.title: The Buffalo Miracle
videos.description: The story of how strangers found sanctuary inside a McDonald's during a blizzard in Buffalo on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: How to Make a Killing
videos.description: Disowned by his obscenely wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

videos.title: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
videos.description: With Americans spending thousands of dollars a year on wellness products, Oobah attempts to hack the industry by selling a so-called beauty serum made of children's tears and a supplement containing lab-grown human meat; after strategizing with marketing gurus, Oobah holds focus groups, sets up popup events and manipulates product ratings to generate buzz.

videos.title: The Gilded Age
videos.description: Agnes tries to regain control of the dinner; Peggy's career sparks a conflict with William; Ada meets Dr. Harris.

videos.title: Red Sparrow
videos.description: Prima ballerina Dominika Egorova faces a bleak and uncertain future after she suffers an injury that ends her career. She soon turns to Sparrow School, a secret intelligence service that trains exceptional young people to use their minds and bodies as weapons. Egorova emerges as the most dangerous Sparrow after completing the sadistic training process. As she comes to terms with her new abilities, Dominika meets a CIA agent who tries to convince her that he is the only person she can trust.

videos.title: Knock Knock
videos.description: Two nubile, stranded women reveal a sinister agenda after they spend the night with a married architect.

videos.title: Cocktail
videos.description: Brian Flanagan (Tom Cruise) wants a high-paying marketing job, but needs a business degree first. Working as a bartender to pay for college, Flanagan is mentored by his veteran boss, Doug Coughlin (Bryan Brown). Together, their showy tricks and charisma command large crowds and tip payments -- until Flanagan and the cynical Coughlin have a falling out. Flanagan moves to Jamaica to raise enough money to open his own bar, where he falls in love with artist Jordan Mooney (Elisabeth Shue).

videos.title: The Gilded Age
videos.description: Agnes tries to regain control of the dinner; Peggy's career sparks a conflict with William; Ada meets Dr. Harris.

videos.title: The Death of Robin Hood
videos.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

videos.title: Stoker
videos.description: India Stoker's (Mia Wasikowska) world comes crashing down when her father (Jacki Weaver) dies in a car accident. Adding to the girl's emotional turmoil is the sudden arrival of Charlie (Matthew Goode), an uncle whom she never knew existed. Charlie moves in with India and her unstable mother (Nicole Kidman), and soon India begins to suspect that this charming and mysterious man has ulterior motives. However, instead of feeling alarmed, India becomes increasingly infatuated with him.

videos.title: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
videos.description: With Americans spending thousands of dollars a year on wellness products, Oobah attempts to hack the industry by selling a so-called beauty serum made of children's tears and a supplement containing lab-grown human meat; after strategizing with marketing gurus, Oobah holds focus groups, sets up popup events and manipulates product ratings to generate buzz.

videos.title: Annabelle
videos.description: John Form thinks he's found the perfect gift for his expectant wife, Mia: a vintage doll in a beautiful white dress. However, the couple's delight doesn't last long: One terrible night, devil worshipers invade their home and launch a violent attack against the couple. When the cultists try to summon a demon, they smear a bloody rune on the nursery wall and drip blood on Mia's doll, thereby turning the former object of beauty into a conduit for ultimate evil.

videos.title: Annabelle: Creation
videos.description: Former toy maker Sam Mullins and his wife, Esther, are happy to welcome a nun and six orphaned girls into their California farmhouse. Years earlier, the couple's 7-year-old daughter Annabelle died in a tragic car accident. Terror soon strikes when one child sneaks into a forbidden room and finds a seemingly innocent doll that appears to have a life of its own.

videos.title: The Roses
videos.description: Life seems easy for picture-perfect couple Theo and Ivy: successful careers, a loving marriage, great kids. However, a tinderbox of fierce competition and hidden resentments soon emerge when Theo's career nosedives and Ivy's own ambitions take off.

videos.title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
videos.description: In 1843 London, author Charles Dickens finds himself in financial trouble after writing three unsuccessful novels in a row. Desperate for a hit, Dickens relies on real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination to bring Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in "A Christmas Carol," forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today.

videos.title: The Slightest Touch Trailer
videos.description: Born with a rare and devastating condition, Emma Fogarty sets out to complete the Dublin Marathon with her longtime friend Colin Farrell.

videos.title: Eddington
videos.description: A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbor is pitted against neighbor in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.

videos.title: When a Witness Recants
videos.description: A 1983 Baltimore school murder leads to three teens' wrongful imprisonment for 36 years. Ta-Nehisi Coates investigates how this case affected the accused, witnesses and their community.

videos.title: The Gilded Age
videos.description: Agnes tries to regain control of the dinner; Peggy's career sparks a conflict with William; Ada meets Dr. Harris.

videos.title: Skyscraper
videos.description: Will Sawyer is a former FBI agent and U.S. war veteran who now assesses security for skyscrapers. While he's on assignment in China, the world's tallest and safest building catches on fire -- and Will gets framed for it. Now a wanted man and on the run, he must find those responsible, clear his name and somehow rescue his family members when they become trapped inside the inferno.

videos.title: Normal
videos.description: The new sheriff of a small town in Minnesota uncovers a dark secret while investigating a botched bank robbery.

videos.title: The Conjuring
videos.description: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history.

videos.title: The Conjuring 2
videos.description: In 1977, paranormal investigators Ed (Patrick Wilson) and Lorraine Warren come out of a self-imposed sabbatical to travel to Enfield, a borough in north London. There, they meet Peggy Hodgson, an overwhelmed single mother of four who tells the couple that something evil is in her home. Ed and Lorraine believe her story when the youngest daughter starts to show signs of demonic possession. As the Warrens try to help the besieged girl, they become the next targets of the malicious spirit.

videos.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
videos.description: In 1986 paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to Pennsylvania to vanquish a demon from a family's home.

videos.title: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
videos.description: Oobah Butler, the gonzo journalist and professional hoax artist, hatches audacious schemes to expose manipulation and corporate nonsense.

videos.title: This Is Not a War Story
videos.description: Some veterans take part in an unusual art project designed to help them deal with the leftover trauma associated with their combat experiences.

videos.title: Just Friends
videos.description: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart.

videos.title: Rain Man
videos.description: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

videos.title: The Housemaid
videos.description: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets.

videos.title: The Post
videos.description: Katharine Graham is the first female publisher of a major American newspaper -- The Washington Post. With help from editor Ben Bradlee, Graham races to catch up with The New York Times to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents. Together, they must overcome their differences as they risk their careers -- and very freedom -- to help bring long-buried truths to light.

videos.title: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
videos.description: Oobah Butler, the gonzo journalist and professional hoax artist, hatches audacious schemes to expose manipulation and corporate nonsense.

videos.title: The Gilded Age
videos.description: As Bertha's ambition shakes New York society, Agnes plots her comeback; Marian seeks independence and Peggy fights for acceptance from her future in-laws.

videos.title: A Minecraft Movie
videos.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

videos.title: Madame Web
videos.description: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead.

videos.title: Love, Simon
videos.description: Everyone deserves a great love story, but for 17-year-old Simon Spier, it's a little more complicated. He hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing.

videos.title: Christmas With the Kranks
videos.description: Finally alone for the holidays, Luther (Tim Allen) and Nora Krank (Jamie Lee Curtis) plan to eschew the Christmas traditions and take a cruise in the Caribbean instead. This doesn't sit well with their Christmas-obsessed neighbors Vic Frohmeyer (Dan Aykroyd) and Walt Scheel (M. Emmet Walsh), who are determined to win the annual "best decorated street" competition, and the Kranks soon find themselves social outcasts because of their lack of Christmas spirit.
